text:
sam: Quick design request for next-week launch: need a benchmark hero (1200x600), a compact webinar signup modal (480x320), and a 15-30s vertical social GIF (1080x1350). Must use brand palette and accessible CTA contrast. Target handoff: Tue 11:59am PT. cc @claire @diego

claire: Got it. Can you share the primary headline and an alt? Also want the figma link and whether JP localization is required.

sam: Primary: 'Production-ready LLM inference 50% lower ops cost.' Alt: 'Ship AI features with predictable latency and cost.' Wait
legal: drop specific percent. New primary: 'Production-ready LLM inference with lower unit cost.' Figma: https://figma.com/file/launch-suite-xyz

diego: We'll do a sparkline visual on hero but abstract numbers only. Add a microcaption: 'Representative benchmark across typical GPUs.' No vendor names.

nina: Legal ask: no absolute percent claims unless we have the certified benchmark slide. Use 'lower' or 'reduced'. I'll review copy once uploaded.

brandbot: Tokens: CTA = #FF3B30, text = Inter, CTA weight = 600, alt high-contrast variant required.

claire: I'll drop hero + modal frames today and a GIF concept Monday AM (ease-in loop). GIF export as mp4 + gif, optimized <2MB.

diego: For analytics provide separate UTMs per headline variant. Sam, send the utm strings?

sam: UTMs: utm_campaign=prod_launch_q2&utm_source=social&utm_variant=headlineA and headlineB. Webinar param: ?webinar_id=2026-04-12

claire: Uploading early drafts to figma now. Ping me here for copy review. Timeline: drafts today, review Mon, final Tue morning.

localebot: JP translation requested: yes. Allow 10-15% extra vertical space for JP headline.
